description: This file contains Kotlin source code defining data classes, singleton objects, and functions related to display and management of tools within an Android application. It focuses on serializing configurations, resolving display summaries, and handling tool-specific details.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Data class representing an action specification with optional label and detail keys.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Data class representing display specifications such as emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Data class representing the overall configuration including version, fallback spec, and tools map.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the summarized information for displaying a tool, including computed properties for detailLine and summaryLine.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object responsible for loading, caching, and resolving display summaries for tools based on configuration and parameters.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, name, args, and meta information.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the configuration JSON from assets, with caching and fallback handling.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly title from a tool name by cleaning and formatting.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by replacing underscores and trimming.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for read actions from args.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts a path detail string from args.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first suitable string value from args based on a list of keys.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Traverses nested JSON args using a dot-separated path to retrieve a specific value.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a JsonElement into a string representation, abbreviated if too long.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces home directory paths in a string with '~'.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to extract string from JsonElement or return null.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to extract numeric value from JsonElement or return null.
